name: retell_outbound_empty_begin_message
summary: Configure outbound voice agents in Retell AI with an empty string or null begin_message to prevent the agent from talking over the call recipient upon pickup.
steps: Create a Single Prompt agent within the Retell AI dashboard.
Set identity, task steps, and hard rules in the system prompt.
Clear the begin_message configuration setting (set to "" or null).
Deploy agent and verify it waits for human pickup greeting before speaking.
jarvis_use: Ensure outbound call agents wait for the call recipient to say hello before starting dialogue.

name: python_arithmetic_override_guardrail
summary: Programmatically recalculate and override financial totals from LLM outputs using Python code prior to document generation.
steps: Receive structured JSON metadata and line items from LLM document generation prompt.
Extract quantity and unit_price values for each line item.
Recompute subtotal and total programmatically in Python using qty * unit_price.
Overwrite LLM-provided numeric totals with the Python-calculated values.
Pass verified JSON data to HTML/PDF generation engine.
jarvis_use: Eliminate arithmetic hallucinations when generating quotes, billing items, and invoices.

name: hardcoded_pin_gating_inbound
summary: Enforce a hard-coded security PIN check prior to passing voice caller inputs to LLM reasoning to prevent prompt injection and unauthorized access.
steps: Intercept inbound call on private hotline service.
Prompt caller for security PIN code.
Evaluate entered digits using programmatic hard-coded validation rules before triggering LLM.
If authentication fails, terminate call immediately without confirming PIN requirements.
If authentication succeeds, pass call state and user context to AI agent.
jarvis_use: Protect private Jarvis hotline tools and user data from unauthorized telephone access.

name: headless_chrome_pdf_printing
summary: Render modern single-page HTML templates into styled PDF documents using Google Chrome in headless command-line mode.
steps: Inject validated document JSON into a single-page HTML template with custom CSS styling.
Save rendered HTML to a local file path.
Construct binary command: /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome --headless --print-to-pdf=out.pdf --no-pdf-header-footer file://{html_path}.
Execute Chrome CLI via local Python execution script.
Verify output PDF file format and layout.
jarvis_use: Generate exact local PDF reports, invoices, and quotes without relying on external PDF rendering libraries.

name: telegram_voice_note_ingestion
summary: Capture audio voice notes via Telegram bot webhooks to trigger automated backend agent tasks.
steps: Receive audio voice note message via Telegram Bot API webhook.
Send audio transcript to Anthropic API (Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Claude Opus) requesting structured JSON representation.
Extract intent, line items, and recipient details.
Trigger secondary downstream actions (e.g., quotes, leads logging, document generation).
jarvis_use: Allow users to issue commands and request document creation using audio voice notes on mobile.

name: structural_data_isolation_security
summary: Limit outbound agent prompts to call-safe briefings to isolate sensitive private records and credentials from phone counterparties.
steps: Create a dedicated call-safe briefing context file for outbound calls.
Restrict agent runtime prompt strictly to public task details (e.g., booking time, name, request).
Exclude private user files, API tokens, and internal OS paths from agent context.
Log call transcripts back to primary private database post-call.
jarvis_use: Prevent telephony agents from accidentally disclosing private data during phone calls.

name: agent_driven_gcal_booking
summary: Automate appointment booking by equipping voice calls with a custom Google Calendar scheduling tool.
steps: Attach gcal_add function tool to Retell AI agent prompt configuration.
Agent negotiates available time slot with vendor during call.
Upon confirming slot, agent executes gcal_add tool call with structured event details.
Calendar tool creates event directly in primary Google Calendar.
jarvis_use: Automatically convert confirmed phone call appointment slots into Google Calendar events.

name: voice_to_lead_quote_invoice_pipeline
summary: Convert incoming voice instructions into leads table entries, HTML/PDF quotes, and editable Google Docs.
steps: Parse client quote instructions from voice transcript into structured JSON.
Verify item totals with Python arithmetic recomputation.
Append lead details to Google Sheets Leads ledger.
Render HTML document and convert to PDF using headless Chrome CLI.
Upload PDF to Google Drive and create editable Google Doc copy.
Send document links back to user via Telegram desktop chat.
jarvis_use: Automate end-to-end sales workflow from voice request to client deliverable generation.

name: 3d_graph_os_visualization
summary: Visualize real-time AI agent interactions, call logs, and state node networks on a local 3D web graph.
steps: Run local web application server listening at localhost:4719.
Render 3D node graph mapping connected tools, caller identities, and file states.
Stream call events and security alerts directly to the visual graph UI in real time.
jarvis_use: Provide visual monitoring and execution trace logs for autonomous system actions.

name: hotline_unauthorized_pin_rejection
summary: Reject unauthorized hotline callers failing PIN checks without revealing authentication logic, logging the event and alerting the user.
steps: Detect PIN code check failure during inbound telephone connection.
Hang up call without confirming PIN validation criteria to caller.
Post event log toast to local 3D Graph UI (Hotline call: An unknown caller rang your private line...).
Dispatch security alert notification message to user via Telegram.
jarvis_use: Handle failed authentication attempts gracefully while keeping system logs and user alerts updated.
